ValidationRule.description: KYC Update cases can be Closed with Resolution or Closed without Resolution.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Case_Validation_Bypass__c.Bypass_Validation__c), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseCategory__c, 'KYC Update'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'New')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'In Progress')), ISBLANK(ParentId), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed with Resolution')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed without Resolution')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: KYC Update cases can be Closed with Resolution or Closed without Resolution.
